What should I be looking at in terms of options trades? I mostly own spy in my portfolio. Straight 5% OTM puts or something else? Around the Block: What's on the radar for the rest of the week? About Mark S. Longo Mark S. Longo is the founder of The Options Insider Inc. - a firm TheOptionsInsider.com , Options Insider Radio , Mr. Longo continues to provide new ways to spread the word about options.Mr. Longo's analysis of the options market has appeared in a wide variety of domestic and international publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Futures Magazine, and more. As one of the few industry commentators with practical options experience, he has developed a substantial following among industry veterans and newcomers looking for insight into this complex market. Mr. Longo began his career as an options trader on the floor of the Chicago Board Options Exchange.
